title: imap: implement ENABLE IMAP4rev2 session latch
description:
Fix the ENABLE command stub in crates/imap/src/session/mod.rs (currently line 453). The stub discards the capabilities field via .. and always returns * ENABLED with an empty list.

Algorithm:
1. Change CommandBody::Enable { .. } to CommandBody::Enable { capabilities }.
2. Iterate capabilities.as_ref(). For each CapabilityEnable::Other(ref _o): check if format!("{cap}").eq_ignore_ascii_case("IMAP4rev2"). (CapabilityEnableOther inner field is private; Display is the only access path.)
3. If found and ctx.imap4rev2_enabled is false: set ctx.imap4rev2_enabled = true; add CapabilityEnable::try_from("IMAP4rev2").expect("valid atom") to the newly_enabled vec.
4. If found and ctx.imap4rev2_enabled is already true: skip (idempotent; do not add to newly_enabled).
5. Build Data::Enabled { capabilities: newly_enabled } and enqueue it, then enqueue the tagged OK.
6. State guard: the existing match on ctx.state must remain — ENABLE in NotAuthenticated must return NO unchanged.

Defensive rules: one-way latch only; never set imap4rev2_enabled back to false. Log the enable event at debug level (no key material involved).

Acceptance: cargo test -p stoa-imap passes; new unit tests (separate bead) cover latch, idempotency, and wrong-state rejection.
